about: Labelled (claim, quote) pairs for the type-grounding judge (scripts/grounding.py). grounded=false are mention-only traps: the quote names the entity (or its type word) without grounding the TYPE claim. grounded=true are quotes a too-strict judge must still accept. gold was written by hand before any judge ran; one case is a real failure from the 2026-11-18 artifact.

cases.why: the name appears, but nothing says what Northwind is

cases.why: ToolX is named; the quote does not make it a company
